output.brief: The latency regression comes from the storage compaction tuning change pushed on the evening of 2 Nov, not from gateway 5.8. In 11 cells the push raised compaction threads from 2 to 6. Disk use went from 41% to 97% within minutes, and latency jumped right after each push. One cell, aps-3, skipped the push but got 5.8, and its latency stayed at about 94 ms. Rolling euw-1 back to 5.7 changed nothing. Network and traffic growth don't explain it. I'm fairly sure (about 90%). Do not roll back the gateway fleet. It would not help and it would reopen the security hole. Do not pause compaction. Backlog would grow toward the 15% danger level. Next, revert the tuning in one cell and watch GET p99 and backlog. If p99 recovers, extend the revert to the other cells. Hold the Orrin rate limit in reserve until the backlog attribution on 10 Nov. Profiling 5.8's CPU use is reasonable but low urgency. Fleet config changes should go on the shared change calendar.
